# norm issuer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/normIssuer>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent or standpoint according to which this norm holds — the constitutional keystone: there is no ought, only ought-according-to. DOMAIN-FREE on purpose: [`gmeow:systemIssuer`](gmeow-systemIssuer.md) specializes this property for NormativeSystems, and a domain of [`Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) would leak [`gmeow:Norm`](../classes/gmeow-Norm.md) typing onto every system through the subproperty design review; issuance applies to norms, systems, and future deontic carriers alike. The range is intentionally open (a [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) or a [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) individual, the [`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) convention). [`normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md) ⊑ [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) is documented, not axiomatised ([`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) is an AnnotationProperty; the vantage precedent). NOT functional: co-issued norms (a treaty, a joint policy) carry several issuers, and those claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.

```turtle

#     there is no ought, only ought-ACCORDING-TO an authority (the keystone).
ex:handwashNorm a gmeow:Norm ;
    rdfs:label            "Staff must wash hands before food preparation"@en ;
    gmeow:deonticModality gmeow:deonticObligation ;
    gmeow:normIssuer      ex:healthAuthority .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent or standpoint according to which a norm (or system, or future deontic carrier) holds — the constitutional keystone that turns an ought into an ought-according-to.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it on any modality-bearing norm (SHACL forbids anonymous oughts) and avoid forcing a single issuer — co-issued treaties and joint policies carry several, so keep it non-functional.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:normIssuer`](gmeow-normIssuer.md) at a [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) or [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) individual; it is documented as ⊑ [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md), so generic standpoint queries see it. For a whole normative system, use the specialization [`gmeow:systemIssuer`](gmeow-systemIssuer.md).
